Promise Robotics signs D.R. Horton agreement for more than 1,250 homes

A multi-year agreement gives the homebuilder access to robotic production capacity without building its own factories.

Promise Robotics / PRNewswire ↗13 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A multi-year production agreement

Promise Robotics announced a commercial agreement with D.R. Horton to support production of more than 1,250 homes through Factory-as-a-Service. Promise calls it the first major US homebuilder on the platform as its US factory network expands.

Connecting designs with production

The platform converts existing home designs into production plans and robot instructions, then coordinates manufacturing, factory operations and site installation. Builders gain access to capacity without developing and operating their own automated factories.

Delivery results remain to be measured

The aim is greater capacity and more predictable cycles amid labour constraints. The agreed home count is not a completed-build count; the release provides neither project-level delivery schedules nor independently verified cost savings.
